answer_1.quote: We propose a two-stage model SIMSUM for document-to-document simplification tasks, which combines text simplification and summarization tasks innovatively.

answer_2.quote: We use standard text simplification evaluation metrics: SARI ... D-SARI ... FKGL ... We also report BLEU when comparing summarization pretraining effects.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation of the outputs from different models. We recruited two expert human evaluators to independently evaluate the generated texts ... Following (Sheang and Saggion, 2021), we select three aspects to define our evaluation criteria: Simplicity (S), Correctness (C), and Fluency (F).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assessed each generated document on three binary criteria: Simplicity (is the output simpler than the original?), Correctness (does the output contain factual errors?), and Fluency (is the output grammatically correct and well‑formed?).
